title: Version 1.68.0

sections.text: Version 1.68.1 (I am literally dancing right now from the spooky month)

body:
Version 1.68.0 (🎃 The SPOOKY MONTH Update! 👻)

October 4th, 2024

Additions:

🍬 | New Currency

  • A limited time currency, Candy, is here!
  • Candy will be used to purchase all of the Halloween content except for gifts.

🦇🏰 | Monstrous Manor

  • A large manor has appeared in front of the Oak Depot!
  • The Manor contains all of the purchasable limited time items for the event.
  • A limited time quest can be found at the manor! (learn more below later)
  • All event items will be removed from the store on November 4th at 12 AM EST. Gifts will also be able to be opened on October 31st at 12 AM EST! Items will return, gifts will not.
  • The Manor contains these items: Small/Tall/Big Candles, a Cauldron, a Coffin, Gravestones, Tombstones, a Hallowed Candlestick, a Hallowed Lantern, Halloween Balloons, three vinyls (a new one by Genisis, art by Peekaboo!), and the Hardened Moon Rod!
  • The Limited time gifts are: the Gift of Spectral Whispers, and the Gift of Crystalized Blood.

🩸🌙 | Blood Moon!

  • Every night, there is a chance for a blood moon to occur. When this happens, massive structures will spawn from below the ground with INVADING ENEMIES!
  • You can use your tools (Axe, Pickaxe, Grabbers) to attack the pesky enemies.
  • The different enemies are the Zombie, Skeleton, Pumpkin Zombie, Sword Skeleton, Goblin, Werewolf, Vampire, and the Headless Horseman
  • All of the drops you can get are some Bones, Pumpkins, Skulls, Zombie Heads, Candycorn, Greeb, a Meat Vinyl Player, Moon Shards, and a Bodyless Horse!

🌓 | Moon Shards

  • Moon Shards will now fall from the sky every night, the current moon phase will decide what the shard variant is!

🤔 | Limited Time Quest (yearly)

  • A new limited time quest has been added to obtain THREE different special tools, you can learn how to do it at the Monstrous Manor! (The Heavenly Pollaxe, Celestial Hammer, and Lunar Staff.)
  • For a little hint: Find the attic.

👁️ | Limited Time Materials

  • A few limited time materials have returned to Oaklands for you to obtain: Sweetstone, Candycorn, Hallow, and Weeping Willow.

💀 | Skeletal Meteor

  • It's raining meteors! The Skeletal Meteor has been added for October, there you can find the special Hallow Tree and obtain a GIANT Hallow Eye!

🎃⛏️ | Mike's Mines

  • A strange shifting has happened in Mike's Mines, for some reason there's massive pumpkins formed of rocks?

🐛 | The Corruption

  • The corruption is spreading all over the Desert... Something doesn't seem right...
  • These (PERMANENT) materials have been added: The Corrupted, Corrupted Acacia Tree, Corrupted Cactus, Corrupted Deadwood, Corrupted Tumbleweed, and Corrupted Limestone.

🎃 | Natural Pumpkins!

  • Pumpkins are spawning all over Finlay Island, each coming with a random size.
  • Have fun finding rare giant variants! (Listen, you all begged for more random stuff, okay!?)

🏠| New Limited Base Preset

  • A new limited time base preset has been added (created by Azylo and Chetti) containing a bunch of fun content, including a few signed tombstones from the developers.

Changes:

  • The price of the Bandsaw has been raised ($9,500 -> $35,000), as well as the Miner's Helmet ($1,250 -> $5,250).
  • A bunch of memory improvements have been made for different things that I can't remember :D
  • Trees should now generate the correct number of fruits!
  • Some messed up fruits/flowers should now be harvestable again!
  • The Plushiest Grabber's bubble shouldn't be too annoying anymore.
  • Grabbers now limit themselves to their starting distance. (Hard to explain, sorry!!!)

Notes:

  • We're up to over 160+ sales on our Grabbiest Grabber plushie. Thank you so much for the support, we truly did not believe we would reach any of our goals! 💖
  • Not to 'plug' too much, but we also have a bunch of other merch on Lootbloc's website!

Version 1.68.1 (I am literally dancing right now from the spooky month)

October 5th, 2024

Changes:

  • Reverted the distance changes with the grabbers
  • Improved performance in regards to saving structures and data size

Manor Changes!!!!

  • There is now more terrain around The Monstrous Manor!
  • Placed more of the same items around The Monstrous Manor
  • Changed the bounding box of the sell region for The Monstrous Manor
  • The Manor now has a spiral staircase instead of a ladder to get to the attic

Moon Shard Improvements!

  • Moon Shards now display their shape and have a unique color

Ownership?

  • The Hallow Eye will now have an owner when chopped
  • Blood Moon Enemies will now give you ownership of the items if you defeat them

Meteor Moment

  • Skeletal meteors are now 2/3 chance per meteor instead of 1/3
  • Meteors will now take 30-60 minutes to spawn rather than 40-90 minutes

Fixed:

  • Fixed not being able to sell any dyes

Version 1.68.2 & Version 1.68.3

October 6th, 2024

Changes:

  • Improved Tutorial & Analytics
  • You can now buy Candy with Robux
  • Added Solo Button in the loading screen

Version 1.68.4 (The Who Asked Update)

Changes:

  • Moon shards now work in a filter conveyor
  • Ghosts are now much more common (1 in 5 -> 1 in 2)
  • The Fusion Coil and Gravity Coil should no longer make items chopped by the moon tools start floating
  • More changes have been made to The Monstrous Manor
  • Some codes are now redeemable again
  • Internal changes
